title: Hi, I’m Alex
label: About
description: I’m Alex Fernandes — traveler, photographer, and the voice behind Alex Journeys. Based in New Jersey, I share destinations from trips I’ve already taken: the routes, the neighborhoods, and the small details I’d tell a friend over coffee.
contentHtml:
Expect trip notes, destination pages, and favorites from the road — not an agency, not a booking service. Just a personal trip journal with room to breathe.

Alex Journeys is my personal trip journal — one traveler, one set of stories.

nextStep.title: New to the journal?
nextStep.body: Start with destinations I’ve visited, then stories from the road, then the resources and trip tools I actually use.
